units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 63b:12">Snh. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>א״ת כבודו אלא כּוֹבְדוֹ</he> Ms. M., v. <cite ref="K00033"><he>כָּבֵד</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 41b:16">Yoma 41ᵇ</cite> <he>בעי כ׳</he> it requires weight (must be heavy so as to sink into the fire).
<cite ref="Yoma 41b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>כדי שיהא בהן כ׳</he> (they are tied together) in order that they may be heavy.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:3">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ</cite> <he>צריך לכבוש את כּוֹבְדוֹ</he> (in putting his hands on the sacrifice) he must press his weight on it; (Bab.
Naz. 5ᵃ כ׳ the feeling of heaviness (of the hair).—כ׳ ראש bending down the head; humble, solemn disposition, opp. קלות ראש.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:1">Ber. V, 1</cite> <he>אין עומדין … כ׳ ראש</he> we must not rise for prayer in any other than a humble &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:4:3">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵈ</cite> top; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 1:2">Tosef. Ab. Zar. I, 2</cite> <he>שואל בשלומו בכ׳ ר׳</he> greet him with a bent head (without ostentation).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 21b:10">M. Kat. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>בשפה רפה ובכ׳ ר׳</he> in an undertone and with solemnity.

senses.gloss: roller or beam of a loom; כ׳ העליון the upper beam from which the warp depends; כ׳ התחתון the lower beam, the roller on which the web is wound as it advances.
